model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity across various block indices for two distinct data categories, 8-Fbit and 4-Fbit. The x-axis is labeled "Block Index" and features a linear scale representing a range of blocks, with numeric tick labels displayed at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 31. The y-axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale ranging from below $10^{-6}$ to $10^{-4}$, with major numeric tick labels at each decade ($10^{-6}$, $10^{-5}$, and $10^{-4}$) and minor horizontal grid lines indicating subdivisions. The 8-Fbit series is represented by solid blue bars spanning the block indices from 22 to 31; it begins at index 22 with a sensitivity value of approximately $6 \times 10^{-6}$, exhibits an overall upward trajectory, and reaches its peak at the final index of 31 with a value of roughly $8 \times 10^{-5}$. The 4-Fbit series is depicted by solid green bars covering the block indices from 0 to 21; it starts at index 0 with a value close to $10^{-6}$, maintains minor fluctuations primarily between $6 \times 10^{-7}$ and $2 \times 10^{-6}$ through index 14, rises to a local peak of approximately $6 \times 10^{-6}$ at index 17, and concludes at index 21 with a value near $5 \times 10^{-6}$.
model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices, categorized by 4-Fbit and 8-Fbit representations. The x-axis is labeled "Block Index" and uses a discrete linear scale ranging from 0 to 31, with numeric tick labels placed at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 31. The y-axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale spanning from $10^{-6}$ to $10^{-4}$, with major tick labels at $10^{-6}$, $10^{-5}$, and $10^{-4}$ accompanied by minor ticks and horizontal dashed grid lines. Rather than lines, the data is depicted using vertical bars that form two distinct series corresponding to the legend. The "4-Fbit" series is represented by solid green bars that cover block indices 0 through 21; these values start at approximately $10^{-6}$ at index 0, experience a minor dip to their lowest point below $10^{-6}$ at index 8, and gradually trend upward to roughly $5 \times 10^{-6}$ by index 21. The "8-Fbit" series is represented by solid blue bars covering block indices 22 through 31; this series begins at approximately $6 \times 10^{-6}$ at index 22 and exhibits a steady, continuous upward trend, culminating in a peak value near $8 \times 10^{-5}$ at the final index of 31.
